title: Database Connection Pooling
summary: Maintaining a reusable pool of database connections to reduce overhead and improve performance.

content.overview: Connection pooling is a technique to maintain a pool of database connections that can be reused. Instead of opening a new connection for each request, applications borrow from the pool and return connections when done.
content.details: Benefits include reduced connection overhead, better resource utilization, and improved application performance. Configuration parameters: pool size of 10-20 connections for most workloads, max lifetime of 30 minutes, and connection timeout of 5 seconds.
